title: Interlock Logic & Cause Effect Matrix - CT-7801 (SEQ-7801)
content:
INTERLOCK LOGIC & CAUSE EFFECT MATRIX: SEQ-7801 (COOLING TOWER FAN (CT-7801) SHUTDOWN LOGIC).
Document No: TJC-LLD-IL-CT-7801, Revision: Rev 3, SIL Level: SIL 1.
Equipment: CT-7801, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-7800-01.
CAUSE & EFFECT MATRIX (TRIPS):
- T1: Fan/gearbox vibration HIGH-HIGH (VSHH-7802 > 9 mm/s, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip Motor (EFF-1), DCS Alarm (EFF-2), Start Spare (EFF-3)
- T2: Gearbox oil temperature HIGH-HIGH (TSHH-7803 > 90 degC, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip Motor (EFF-1), DCS Alarm (EFF-2), Start Spare (EFF-3)
- T3: Gearbox oil pressure LOW (PSL-7807 < 0.8 barg, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip Motor (EFF-1), DCS Alarm (EFF-2)
- T4: Fan motor overload (MPR-7801 MPR pickup, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip Motor (EFF-1), DCS Alarm (EFF-2), Start Spare (EFF-3)
START PERMISSIVES (AND-gate conditions to start pump):
- P1: Gearbox oil level OK (LG gearbox, Gate Logic: AND)
- P2: Basin level normal (> LSL-7804) (LT-7804, Gate Logic: AND)
- P3: No fan lockout / maintenance key released (lockout, Gate Logic: AND)
- —: ALL permissives TRUE → START CT-7801 ENABLED (—, Gate Logic: AND)
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-7801, Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-CT-7801.
